goal: Is ke baad aap built-in (library) functions ko user-defined functions se alag pehchaan sakein ge, chaaron combinations (parameters ke saath ya baghair, return value ke saath ya baghair) likh sakein ge, aur bata sakein ge ke return statement kya karta hai aur function ko kahan khatam kar deta hai.
warmup: Mobile shop par aap ready-made SIM kharid sakte hain, ya dukaandaar se kehte hain ke aap ke liye custom package bana de. Ready-made cheezein istemal mein tez hoti hain: bas maang lo. Custom cheezein aap ko khud set up karni parti hain. Functions bhi aise hi hain. Kuch ready-made hote hain aur C++ ke saath aate hain (built-in). Baaqi aap khud likhte hain (user-defined). Aur kuch workers aap ko kuch wapas dete hain (receipt: return value) aur kuch sirf ek kaam karte hain (farsh saaf karna: koi return value nahi).
definition: Built-in (library) functions pehle se C++ ne likhe hote hain. Aap sahi header #include se shamil karte hain aur unhein call karte hain. Misalein: <cmath> se sqrt, pow, ceil, floor; <cstdlib> se abs aur rand; <cctype> se toupper. User-defined functions aap apne program ke liye khud likhte hain, jaise printLine() ya average(). Function koi value return kar sakta hai (us ka return type int, double, char... hota hai) ya kuch bhi return nahi karta (us ka return type void hota hai). Function parameters (inputs) bhi le sakta hai ya koi nahi. Is liye chaar combinations hain: na parameters na return value, parameters aur koi return value nahi, koi parameters nahi aur return value, parameters aur return value. Return statement function ko foran khatam kar deta hai aur value wapas bhej deta hai.
howItWorks: Built-in function bilkul user-defined function ki tarah kaam karta hai: aap usay call karte hain, woh chalta hai, aur value return karta hai. Farq sirf yeh hai ke usay likha kis ne. Trace aur us ka call stack dekhein: jab sqrt(81) chal raha hota hai to woh main() ke upar baitha hota hai, phir jab woh 9 return karta hai to ghayab ho jata hai. Apne functions ke liye do sawal tay karein. 1) Kya function ko caller se maloomat chahiye? To usay parameters dein. 2) Kya caller ko jawab wapas chahiye? To usay return type dein aur return use karein. Agar function sirf kuch print karta hai ya koi kaam karta hai to void use karein. Zaroori rule: return function ko foran khatam kar deta hai. Jis raaste mein return pohanch jaye, us ke baad ka koi statement kabhi nahi chalta. Jis function ka return type void ke ilawa kuch aur ho, usay har raaste par value return karni hoti hai. void function return ke saath value use nahi karta (jaldi nikalne ke liye saada return; use kar sakta hai).
